rv.q: David Staller’s amusingly tinkered with Pygmalion is as fair as can be.
Fittingly, this luminous revival also marks the 20th anniversary of the Gingold Theatrical Group, a company that honors Shaw’s spirit with imagination, intellect, and heart.

cn.t: Critics praise this witty revival of Shaw's classic, though Staller's bold addition of a mythic framing device with Olympian gods divides opinion on whether it enhances or distracts from the original comedy.
